related_questions.question: How much is a good retirement plan?
related_questions.snippet: There is no single retirement target that covers everyone; it depends on what you expect your retirement to look like. The rule of thumb is to have enough to draw down 80% to 90% of your pre-retirement income. Or, using a simple formula like saving 12 times your pre-retirement salary is also a good rule of thumb.
